summary: Iter 85 — Gift Cards feature (public purchase, Razorpay + UPI, admin confirm/cancel, POS redeem). Backend: 12/12 pytest cases pass across config, settings, UPI flow (order→upi-paid→admin list→confirm→code+expires ~180d), Razorpay order (real order_id via HQ keys, key_id rzp_*), Razorpay verify wrong-sig=400, scheduled delivery (send_on=tomorrow → status=scheduled, code hidden), validation (bad email/unknown occasion=400, amount<=0=422), POS check + create-invoice with gift_card_code deducts balance, cancel makes code invalid. Frontend: /gift/miracurl-marathahalli fully works (12 occasions, amount presets+custom, preview updates with occasion gradient + amount, form fields, send-now/later toggle, UPI E2E → gift-success screen). Razorpay checkout modal opens (real api.razorpay.com iframe). /book/… hero-gift-card-btn & /salon/… salon-gift-card-btn both linked correctly. Salon-admin Settings shows gift-cards-card with all fields, gift-page-url, stats row, gift-row-*, gift-confirm-*, gift-cancel-*. CRITICAL BUG FOUND & FIXED in POS.jsx: missing useState declarations for gcCode / gcInfo caused entire POS page to crash with 'gcInfo is not defined' React error. Two lines added, POS now renders and pos-gift-card-box (input+apply+applied+remove) works end-to-end.

ui_bugs.issue: Missing `useState` for gcCode / gcInfo caused runtime error 'gcInfo is not defined' — entire POS page crashed (ErrorBoundary 'Something went off-script'). FIXED by testing agent (added 2 useState lines).

action_items: Verify the POS.jsx useState fix is acceptable / consider whether gcCode/gcInfo should be initialized elsewhere (e.g., reset after invoice create). Currently they are cleared on remove but not automatically after checkout — main agent may want to reset gcCode/gcInfo when the invoice is created successfully, else the applied gift card sticks in UI state after cart clears.
Optional: whats-new modal (z-[80]) intercepts pointer events on Settings — same issue reported in prior iterations; make it dismissable via Escape or auto-close after first sight.
critical_code_review_comments: POS.jsx used gcCode/gcInfo state without declaring the hooks — a linter/CI check (react/no-undef) would have caught this pre-merge.

routes/gift_cards.py `pay_method` validation ordering — the 'razorpay' and 'upi' method-specific enable checks happen before the fallback 'Unknown payment method' check; harmless but the unknown-method 400 is unreachable when pay_method is neither. Consider validating pay_method first.
gift_cards.py `confirm_gift_card` — sets confirmed_by, then _issue_gift_card overwrites doc; fine but confirmed_by is not returned in the response.
GiftCardsCard.jsx admin uses window.confirm() for confirm/cancel — this native dialog is auto-accepted by Playwright but not testable easily; consider a themed modal for consistency.
gift_card.check returns valid=False (200) whereas redeem_gift_card raises 400 — consistent but frontend must handle both paths.
public gift-cards/{gcid}/upi-paid — no signature/HMAC on the buyer-supplied upi_ref; admin owner must eyeball the UPI ref (documented in playbook).

success_rate.frontend: 100% of scripted flows (public gift page, Razorpay modal, Settings card render, POS gift box) after applying the POS useState fix

seed_data_creation: Created ~5 test gift cards under miracurl-marathahalli (buyer.test@/rzp/etc. gmail.com; codes GC-*). Also created 1 test invoice via API for redeem test. Also set gift_card_settings.upi_id='testsalon@upi' on this tenant per instructions (please keep or override).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gift Cards feature is fully working after adding 2 missing useState hooks in POS.jsx (gcCode/gcInfo). Backend and frontend flows validated. If retesting: use test_iter85_gift_cards.py (auto-generates fresh cards each run). POS page fix must remain — confirm gcCode/gcInfo useState still present near tipStaffId. Razorpay HQ fallback works because tenant is 'miracurl-marathahalli'.
rca of the issue: POS.jsx referenced gcCode/gcInfo state variables (lines 191, 208-213, 222, 244, 335-344) but the corresponding `useState` calls were never declared. On mount, React evaluated `giftApplied = gcInfo ? Math.min(gcInfo.balance, total) : 0` and threw ReferenceError. Fix: added `const [gcCode, setGcCode] = useState(""); const [gcInfo, setGcInfo] = useState(null);` alongside the other useState declarations. Reproduction: navigate to /pos after login → whole page replaced by ErrorBoundary showing 'gcInfo is not defined'. After fix: POS renders normally, gift box accepts a code and shows applied amount + balance.
